snippet.title: Invincible VS | Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to the Invincible Universe, Ella Mental. 

The all-new character, created by Robert Kirkman & Cory Walker joins the roster of 18 fighters.

Invincible VS launches on April 30, 2026 for Xbox, PC, and PS5. Preorder now: InvincibleVS.com

Preorder Invincible VS and receive the Zero Suit Mark cosmetic and 4 color variants.

https://invinciblevs.com/#preorder

Invincible VS is by @Skybound and in-house studio Quarter Up.
